cases.input: A reusable desktop PASS is stored only as scalar PASS with no source revision or target-condition identity.
Browser target PASS is used to close Design KEEP, professional acceptance or field validity.
Simulation is user-facing on desktop/mobile but the truth boundary exists only in repository metadata, not those rendered targets.
Two transport/runtime chunks from one semantic image are counted as two independent visual sources.
An older dependency manifest is claimed to completely cover a newer current source revision.
Runtime slot MAIN role is used to promote design review state and source authority.
Section/page count change without scope labels is used as proof of source mutation/content loss.
Reduced-motion behavior is treated as a separate Style identity even though information architecture and semantic role are unchanged.
Vercel deployment status passes, external content readback is NOT_EVALUATED, but external content PASS is inferred from deployment.
